question: Which of the following banks was declared as the ’Safest Bank in Asia’ for the 12th consecutive year by New York-based trade publication ‘Global Finance’ in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DBS**__.

__
 
• **Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, India, China, Taiwan, Regional, 20 Oct 2020 - DBS Bank has been named the “Safest Bank in Asia” for the 12th consecutive year by New York-based trade publication Global Finance**.
